_comentario: First Numbers, Part 1 (autumn, days 1-65): the English text of each day of Aprendo los números -- the sentence from the story that the grown-up reads out ('frase', with the day's number in words), and the text of its activity: 'prompt' for 'dibuja', 'checklist' and 'prompt' for 'repasa' (Friday), 'texto' for 'problema'. Everything else about the day (the number, the pictures, the activity) is the one in content/q1.json, page by page: see cargar_traduccion in tools/gen_numeros.py. British English, like First Words and Read and Draw.

dias.frase: Lucía has one dog, and his name is Toby.
Mum gives Lucía one red apple for break time.
Dani has one blue balloon, and he won't let go of it, not even to eat.
Today there is one big sun in the sky, and the family goes out to the park.
dias.prompt: Draw 1 big sun, and Lucía playing under it.

dias.frase: Lucía makes a drawing for each one of them: Mum, Dad, Dani and Grandma Rosa.
checklist: I can see where there is just 1 thing.
dias.prompt: Draw Lucía's family, and 1 big heart for everyone.

dias.frase: Toby runs in from the garden and leaves two paw prints on the rug.
Toby loves playing with two balls at once.
Dad brings Toby two new bones, and Toby hides one.
At night, Lucía and Dani can see two stars from the window.
Grandma Rosa brings two sweets: one for Lucía and one for Dani.
dias.prompt: Draw Toby playing with his 2 balls.

dias.frase: Lucía has three new pencils in her blue school bag.
Her teacher, Marta, brings three storybooks to class.
Three school bags hang on the pegs in the classroom, and Lucía's is the blue one.
Marta puts three stars on Lucía's drawing.
When she gets home from school, Lucía gives Mum three kisses.
There are four very tall trees in the park near Lucía's house.
Lucía and Dani go to the park with Toby, and they take four balls.
There are four dogs playing in the park, and one of them is Toby.
For a snack in the park, Dad brings four biscuits.
Back home, Toby leaves four muddy paw prints by the door.
dias.prompt: Draw your favourite park, with 4 trees.

dias.frase: There are five apples in the fruit bowl in the kitchen.
Mum cracks five eggs to make a potato omelette.
For pudding, Grandma Rosa brings five lemon sweets.
Toby waits under the table, and he has five bones hidden in his bed.
Five of them live in Lucía's house: Dad, Mum, Lucía, Dani and Toby.
dias.prompt: Draw the kitchen table, with 5 plates.

dias.frase: Four orange leaves have already fallen from the tree in the street.
In the afternoons, the cold wind brings two grey clouds.
Now that it is autumn, you can see three squirrels in the park looking for food.
Dani jumps into a pile of leaves, and five leaves get stuck in his hair.
You can tell autumn is here: there is one tree in the street that is all orange.
checklist: I know the numbers from 1 to 5.
dias.prompt: Draw an autumn tree, with 5 leaves on the ground.

dias.frase: Dani has a box with six little cars in it.
In the toy box there are six coloured balls too.
Sometimes Dani leaves his six cars all over the living room.
Lucía helps Dani put away his six dinosaurs before dinner.
Dani sticks six stars on his toy box.
dias.prompt: Draw Dani's toy box, with 6 toys.

dias.frase: The family eats all the chestnuts, and there are none left in the basket.
Dad roasts the chestnuts outside, and the basket is left empty: zero chestnuts.
Careful, they're hot! Nobody can take a chestnut yet.
Dani eats so many chestnuts that there is nothing left on his plate.
That night, the whole house smells of chestnuts, but there are none left.
checklist: I know that 0 means there is nothing.
dias.prompt: Draw the chestnut basket, empty: 0 chestnuts.

dias.frase: Tomorrow Lucía will be seven, and her cake will have seven candles.
Today is Lucía's birthday, and Dad hangs seven balloons in the living room.
Mum makes her a strawberry cake, her favourite, with seven candles.
Sofía and Marta come round for tea, and Lucía opens seven presents.
At the end of the party, Sofía takes seven sweets home.
dias.prompt: Draw Lucía's cake, with its 7 candles.

dias.frase: Eight little spiders live on the wall of Pedro's garden, next door.
Eight ducks swim on the pond in the park.
Luna, Pedro's cat, sunbathes on the wall with her friends: eight cats.
In the park, eight birds sing early every morning.
Lucía loves all animals, even the eight fish in the fountain.
dias.prompt: Draw a spider, with its 8 legs.

dias.frase: It is raining hard today, and there are nine raindrops on the window.
Lucía puts on her wellies and her yellow raincoat, and counts nine grey clouds.
Dani would rather stay at home and play with nine cars.
There are nine wet umbrellas by the school door.
In the afternoon, the wind blows the nine clouds away, and the sun comes out.
dias.prompt: Draw Lucía with her umbrella, and 9 raindrops.

dias.frase: On Saturday, at the market, Mum buys ten eggs.
The market smells of tangerines, and Mum buys ten.
Mum buys turrón, and ten stars for the Christmas tree.
Dani asks for ten new toys, but Mum tells him to wait for the Three Kings.
At the fruit stall, Lucía and Dani are given ten sweets.
dias.prompt: Draw the fruit stall at the market, with 10 pieces of fruit.

dias.frase: For Christmas Eve, Lucía and Dani stick ten stars on the window.
Lucía and Dani hang seven red and gold baubles on the tree.
Grandma Rosa comes to spend Christmas Eve with them, and she brings nine presents.
They all have dinner together, and there are eight lit candles on the table.
After dinner, there is no turrón left in the basket.
checklist: I know the numbers from 0 to 10.
I can trace all the numbers, from 0 to 10.
dias.prompt: Draw Lucía's Christmas tree, with 10 baubles.
